title: V6.2 Stage 2b: Actionability ONLY (entry/failure_exit; called only for CANDIDATE/HIGH_CONVICTION)
description: NEW schema, added after real-model canary runs 35482706294/35485028854 showed decision=CANDIDATE repeatedly paired with entry.status=NOT_ACTIONABLE and null prices. This call is only ever made after Stage 2a's decision is already known to be CANDIDATE/HIGH_CONVICTION, so entry.status and failure_exit.trigger_type's enums here structurally EXCLUDE the non-actionable values (NOT_ACTIONABLE / UNAVAILABLE) -- they are not valid JSON for this response at all, not merely discouraged.

status.description: NOT_ACTIONABLE is intentionally not a valid value in this schema -- this call only happens when the decision is already known to be actionable.

trigger_type.description: UNAVAILABLE is intentionally not a valid value in this schema.
